title: PASET Regional Scholarship and Innovation Fund (RSIF) PhD Scholarships
description:
PhD scholarships in applied sciences, engineering and technology at African host universities, with a 6-12 month sandwich placement abroad.

  • Full PhD scholarship
  • Research and sandwich placement abroad
  • Mobility grants for scholars

Eligibility: Sub-Saharan African citizens with a relevant master’s, not holding another PhD scholarship; priority for women and young faculty, usually 35 or under.

How to apply: The last call closed on 16 September 2024; a new call has not been announced, so the dates shown are an estimate.

title: Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) Program
provider: African Development Bank / Government of Japan
description:
Two-year master’s scholarships at partner universities in Japan (Kyoto, Tokyo, Hiroshima, Sophia, APU and others) in energy, agriculture, health, environment and engineering.

  • Tuition
  • Monthly stipend
  • Round-trip airfare
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Nationals of AfDB regional member countries living in their home country, 35 or under, with a related bachelor’s and at least one year of paid work in Africa within the last three years.

How to apply: Apply to a JADS partner university; the university nominates you to the Bank. Deadlines follow each university’s intake.

title: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies Scholarships
description:
Most master’s places at the Doha Institute come with full scholarships, and PhD students receive multi-phase funding.

  • Full or partial master’s scholarships
  • PhD funding covering tuition and housing

Eligibility: Admitted master’s and PhD students; doctoral applicants must show financial need and hold no other scholarship.

How to apply: Apply through the Doha Institute admissions portal; the deadline shown is an estimate.

title: KFUPM Graduate Scholarship
provider: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
description:
Full scholarships for international graduate students at KFUPM, Saudi Arabia’s leading engineering university.

  • Tuition-free study
  • Monthly stipend by scholarship category
  • Free furnished housing with utilities
  • Air tickets
  • Medical and dental care

Eligibility: International applicants with strong records (e.g. GPA above 3.2/4 in some departments) and English (TOEFL iBT 70 / IELTS 6.0); all PhD programmes and some MS programmes.

How to apply: Apply through the KFUPM graduate admissions portal; the deadline shown is an estimate.

title: OAS Academic Scholarship Program
description:
Organization of American States scholarships for graduate study and research in OAS member states.

  • Up to USD 10,000 per academic year (complementary funding)
  • Up to two academic years

Eligibility: Citizens or permanent residents of OAS member states with a university degree; medical sciences and language learning are not funded. Recipients must return home for 24 months.

How to apply: Apply through your country’s National Liaison Office; the 2027 call dates are an estimate.

title: Sogang Global Scholarship (Graduate)
description:
Language-based tuition awards for international graduate students at Sogang University in Seoul.

  • 80% of tuition with TOPIK 6, IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 100
  • 50% or 30% for lower language tiers

Eligibility: International graduate students meeting the language thresholds; keep a GPA of 3.5/4.3.

How to apply: Awarded automatically to eligible admitted students.

title: Sogang Global Scholarship I (Undergraduate)
description:
Tuition scholarships for international undergraduates with excellent academic performance at Sogang.

  • Full, 2/3, 1/3 or 1/6 of tuition

Eligibility: International undergraduates with excellent results (2.5 GPA in the previous semester to continue).

How to apply: Check Sogang’s international admissions calendar.

title: Sogang GSIS Scholarships
provider: Sogang University Graduate School of International Studies
description:
Admission scholarships for master’s students in international studies at Sogang GSIS.

  • Scholarship A-D: 100%, 75%, 50% or 25% of tuition
  • From semester 2, set by GPA

Eligibility: Admitted GSIS master’s students.

How to apply: Apply through GSIS admissions (fee KRW 90,000 / USD 90).

title: Chung-Ang University TOPIK Tuition Scholarship
description:
Tuition reductions for international undergraduates at Chung-Ang with strong Korean, plus GPA-based waivers later.

  • 50% off tuition with TOPIK 5, 100% with TOPIK 6
  • From semester 2: 20%-100% waiver by GPA

Eligibility: International undergraduates (not the School of Medicine).

How to apply: Submit TOPIK results with your application.

title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
provider: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
description:
Monthly stipends and/or tuition waivers for degree-seeking international students at NYCU in Hsinchu and Taipei.

  • Monthly stipend, tuition waiver, or both (per NYCU regulations)

Eligibility: International degree students without a Taiwan government award; GPA 3.5 (graduate) or 3.0 (undergraduate) to renew; Mandarin courses required.

How to apply: Incoming students apply with their admission application.

title: NTUST Scholarship for International Graduate Students
provider: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (Taiwan Tech)
description:
Full and partial one-year scholarships for international master’s and PhD students at Taiwan Tech.

  • Full award: NT$12,000 (master’s) or NT$18,000 (PhD) a month
  • Possible one-year tuition and fee waiver

Eligibility: International holders of a foreign bachelor’s or master’s applying full-time to NTUST graduate programmes (not for bachelor’s students).

How to apply: Apply with your graduate admission application; numbers depend on the annual budget.

title: Lingnan University Scholarships for Non-local Undergraduates
description:
Automatic entrance scholarships for non-local applicants to Lingnan’s first-year undergraduate programme (tuition HK$205,000 in 2027-28).

  • Full scholarship: tuition, hostel and partial living expenses
  • Full-tuition and half-tuition scholarships
  • Renewable for the normal study period

Eligibility: Non-local applicants to Lingnan’s UGC-funded first-year programme.

How to apply: Awarded automatically; no separate application.

title: EdUHK Entrance Scholarships for Non-local Students
provider: The Education University of Hong Kong
description:
Entrance scholarships for non-local undergraduates at the Education University of Hong Kong.

  • Full scholarship HK$240,000 (tuition, accommodation and living allowance)
  • Tuition scholarship HK$180,000
  • Half-tuition scholarship HK$90,000

Eligibility: Non-local undergraduate applicants; considered automatically.

How to apply: No separate application.

title: HKU Entrance Scholarships for International Students
description:
Entrance scholarships for outstanding international undergraduates at the University of Hong Kong, up to full tuition, accommodation and living allowance.

  • Up to full tuition fees
  • Accommodation and general living allowance for top awards

Eligibility: Outstanding international applicants to HKU undergraduate programmes.

How to apply: Considered with your HKU application; apply by the international admission deadline.

title: HKU Belt and Road Scholarship (HKSAR Government Scholarship Fund)
provider: The University of Hong Kong / HKSAR Government
description:
A full-tuition entrance scholarship at HKU for nationals of Belt and Road countries such as Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Myanmar.

  • Entrance scholarship equal to full non-local tuition

Eligibility: Nationals of participating Belt and Road countries applying to HKU undergraduate programmes.

How to apply: The application deadline is 31 January 2027.

title: Monash International Leadership Scholarship (100% Tuition)
description:
Four scholarships a year covering 100% of course fees for outstanding international undergraduates at Monash.

  • 100% of course fees for the length of the degree (not OSHC, accommodation or living costs)

Eligibility: International students with a full, unconditional Monash undergraduate offer, studying full-time in Australia (not Australian Year 12 students or the MD); keep a WAM of 70 and join the Campus Ambassador Program.

How to apply: No separate application: undergraduate offer holders are considered automatically.

title: Sir John Monash Scholarship for Excellence
description:
Monash’s scholarship for the top 10 incoming students with exceptional school results.

  • Up to AUD 40,000

Eligibility: Top students with an ATAR of 98+ or equivalent IB/Year 12 results.

How to apply: Check the Monash scholarship listing for 2027 terms.

title: Monash International Study Grants for South Asia and Vietnam
description:
Automatic grants for applicants from India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Vietnam to Monash undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

  • AUD 5,000, 10,000 or 15,000 depending on assessment

Eligibility: Applicants from Vietnam, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka or Nepal for 2027 undergraduate or postgraduate courses.

How to apply: Assessed automatically when you apply.

title: George Swinburne International Excellence Scholarship
description:
30% off tuition for the course for high-achieving international students starting at Swinburne’s Hawthorn campus in 2027.

  • 30% off tuition for the standard course duration

Eligibility: International students starting for the first time in 2027 at Hawthorn with excellent results.

How to apply: Check the Swinburne page for how to be considered.

title: Swinburne International Scholarship
description:
20% off tuition for international students at Swinburne in Melbourne.

  • 20% off tuition fees

Eligibility: International students admitted to eligible Swinburne courses.

How to apply: Check the Swinburne page for eligible courses and intakes.

title: Swinburne Women in Engineering Leadership Scholarship
description:
A 30% tuition scholarship for international women studying specific engineering courses at Swinburne.

  • 30% off tuition fees

Eligibility: International women admitted to eligible engineering courses.

How to apply: Check the Swinburne page for eligible courses.

title: La Trobe Artificial Intelligence Scholarship
description:
Scholarships of 50% or 100% of tuition for international students starting AI courses at La Trobe in 2026 or 2027.

  • 50% or 100% upfront tuition reduction (30% tier also available)

Eligibility: International students in eligible AI courses; the 100% tier is not open to holders of another La Trobe scholarship.

How to apply: Apply via the scholarship page; the date shown is an estimate.

title: La Trobe Health Innovation Scholarship
description:
Tuition scholarships of 30%, 50% or 100% for international students in health courses at La Trobe, based on WAM.

  • 30% tuition reduction
  • 50% or 100% for higher WAM (application required)

Eligibility: International students in eligible health courses.

How to apply: Apply via the scholarship page for the higher tiers; the date shown is an estimate.

title: La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship
description:
Up to 25% off tuition for high-achieving international students at La Trobe, based on prior marks.

  • 20%-25% tuition reduction depending on WAM
  • Early Acceptance Grant of AUD 2,000 also available

Eligibility: International students admitted to eligible La Trobe courses with strong prior results.

How to apply: Assessed with your application.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) at Zhejiang University
description:
Full Chinese Government Scholarships under the Chinese University Program, awarded through Zhejiang University to international master’s and PhD applicants.

  • Tuition
  • Free dormitory or accommodation allowance
  • Monthly stipend
  • Comprehensive medical insurance

Eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; generally under 35 for master’s and under 40 for PhD. Shortlisted applicants have a video interview with the academic school.

How to apply: Apply in the CSC online system (agency number 10335) and on the university’s own admission system. The 2026 deadline was 31 December 2025; expect a similar year-end deadline (application fee RMB 800).

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) at Tsinghua University
description:
Full Chinese Government Scholarships under the Chinese University Program, awarded through Tsinghua University to international master’s and PhD applicants.

  • Tuition
  • Free dormitory or accommodation allowance
  • Monthly stipend
  • Comprehensive medical insurance

Eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; generally under 35 for master’s and under 40 for PhD. You must be pre-admitted by Tsinghua and recommended by the department; highly competitive.

How to apply: Apply in the CSC online system (agency number 10003) and on the university’s own admission system. Details for 2027 are “coming soon”; the deadline shown is an estimate.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
provider: China Scholarship Council / Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
description:
Full Chinese Government Scholarships under the Chinese University Program, awarded through Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) to international master’s and PhD applicants.

  • Tuition
  • Free dormitory or accommodation allowance
  • Monthly stipend
  • Comprehensive medical insurance

Eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; generally under 35 for master’s and under 40 for PhD. Upload the CSC form to HUST’s online admission system.

How to apply: Apply in the CSC online system (agency number 10487) and on the university’s own admission system. The master’s and doctoral window runs 15 October 2026 to 25 February 2027.

title: Tsinghua University Tuition Scholarship for International Students
description:
Full or partial tuition scholarships for international graduate students at Tsinghua, awarded competitively each year.

  • Full or partial tuition for one academic year (renewable by annual application)

Eligibility: International master’s and doctoral students at Tsinghua.

How to apply: Apply each year through Tsinghua’s financial aid system; the date shown is an estimate.

title: Youth of Excellence Scheme of China (YES China) at HUST
provider: Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Chinese Government
description:
A one-year Chinese Government-funded master’s in International Business or Public Administration at HUST for young professionals.

  • Tuition
  • Accommodation
  • Living allowance
  • Comprehensive medical insurance

Eligibility: Young professionals from eligible countries applying for the YES China master’s programmes.

How to apply: The 2026 deadline was 31 March 2026; the 2027 date is an estimate.

title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students
description:
Automatic merit scholarships for non-EU students starting at Dublin City University in 2027-28.

  • Up to EUR 5,000 (Engineering and Computing)
  • Up to EUR 6,100 (Science and Health)
  • EUR 2,000-2,800 (Business School)
  • EUR 1,850-2,000 (Humanities and Social Sciences)

Eligibility: Non-EU applicants to DCU programmes; values depend on faculty and programme.

How to apply: You are considered automatically when you apply.

title: University College Cork International Merit Scholarships
description:
College-level merit scholarships for international students at UCC, many awarded automatically.

  • Merit-based fee reductions by college and school

Eligibility: Non-EU students admitted to UCC programmes; some schemes depend on the home country’s Human Development Index.

How to apply: Check the UCC international scholarships table for 2027 terms.

title: University of Limerick International Scholarships
description:
Faculty scholarships for non-EU postgraduate students at the University of Limerick.

  • EUR 2,000-2,500 per year

Eligibility: Non-EU students starting eligible UL programmes.

How to apply: The 2027 application period is to be confirmed; the date shown is an estimate.

title: University of Trento Scholarships for International Students
description:
Merit scholarships plus a tuition waiver for non-EU students living abroad, awarded from the admission ranking.

  • EUR 7,200 a year (EUR 8,500 for women in STEM)
  • Tuition waived
  • Up to 2 years (master’s) or 3 years (bachelor’s), renewed on credits

Eligibility: Non-EU citizens living abroad who apply for admission to a Trento degree.

How to apply: No separate application: the admission ranking decides; check the non-EU admission calls for 2027 deadlines.

title: Ca’ Foscari University Honours Scholarships for International Students
description:
Renewable EUR 10,000-a-year scholarships for high-achieving international students starting at Ca’ Foscari in 2027/28.

  • 8 bachelor’s awards of EUR 10,000 a year for three years
  • 20 master’s awards of EUR 10,000 a year for two years

Eligibility: International students enrolling in Italian- or English-taught programmes in 2027/28.

How to apply: Check the Ca’ Foscari page for the 2027/28 call deadlines.

title: Université Côte d’Azur IdEx Academic Excellence Scholarship
description:
Ten IdEx scholarships a year for the best international MSc candidates at Université Côte d’Azur in Nice.

  • Tuition exemption
  • EUR 5,000 stipend for one year

Eligibility: Candidates applying to one of UCA’s international MSc programmes, selected on academic excellence.

How to apply: Applications usually open in spring (March-May).

title: PSL Graduate Programs Excellence Grants
description:
Scholarships for M1 and M2 students in PSL’s graduate programmes, based on excellence, motivation and sometimes need.

  • For example EUR 1,200 a month for 10 months (Computer Science programme)

Eligibility: Master’s applicants to PSL graduate programmes; eligibility varies by programme.

How to apply: Apply with your master’s application; dates vary by programme.

title: Graduate Institute Geneva Master’s Financial Aid
description:
Need- and merit-based scholarships for about 10-15% of new master’s students at the Geneva Graduate Institute.

  • Full or partial scholarships (up to CHF 20,000 over two years) or tuition reductions
  • Specific awards for refugees and Afghan women

Eligibility: Master’s applicants with financial need and strong academic records.

How to apply: Apply for aid in your admission application by 15 January 2027; later requests are not accepted.

title: USI Foundation Scholarships for International Master’s Students
description:
Ten CHF 4,000 scholarships for first-year master’s students in Lugano who finished school abroad.

  • CHF 4,000 for the first year

Eligibility: First-year master’s students at the Lugano faculties who had legal residence abroad when they finished high school.

How to apply: Apply with the online form sent with your admission letter; the 2026/27 deadline was 31 July 2026.

title: IE University Undergraduate Scholarships
description:
Scholarships covering 40% to 100% of tuition for undergraduates from around the world at IE University in Madrid and Segovia.

  • 40%-100% of tuition depending on profile and need
  • One award covers 100% of tuition for the full degree

Eligibility: Candidates worldwide for single-degree bachelor’s programmes (dual and partner degrees excluded).

How to apply: Complete admission and scholarship applications before 15 April 2027 for the best chance.

title: University of Navarra Master’s Scholarships
description:
Scholarships for master’s students of any nationality at the University of Navarra in Pamplona.

  • Up to 80% of enrolment costs plus a monthly stipend (Economics and Finance master’s)
  • 10%-50% awards on other master’s programmes

Eligibility: Master’s applicants from any country.

How to apply: Check the scholarship page for each programme’s deadline.

title: ARES International Training Scholarships (Belgium)
provider: ARES – Académie de recherche et d’enseignement supérieur
description:
Belgian development-cooperation scholarships for specialised master’s and training courses on development topics at French-speaking Belgian universities.

  • Full scholarship for the course (tuition, living, travel and insurance)

Eligibility: Permanent residents working in one of the 31 ARES partner countries, with the required degree and professional experience for the chosen course.

How to apply: The 2027-28 call closed on 18 September 2026; the next call is expected around September 2027.

title: ARES Scholarship – Specialized Master in International and Development Economics
description:
Ten ARES scholarships for a one-year specialised master’s in international and development economics in Belgium.

  • Full ARES scholarship
  • 10 scholarships

Eligibility: Residents of ARES partner countries with a 5-year degree (or 4 years plus 2 years’ experience) and a solid background in economics.

How to apply: Apply in the ARES International Training call; the date shown is an estimate.

title: ARES Scholarship – Advanced Master in Microfinance
description:
Ten ARES scholarships for the one-year English-taught Advanced Master in Microfinance in Belgium.

  • Full ARES scholarship
  • 10 scholarships

Eligibility: Residents of ARES partner countries meeting the programme’s admission criteria.

How to apply: Apply in the ARES International Training call; the date shown is an estimate.

title: Evangelisches Studienwerk Villigst Doctoral Scholarship
description:
A Protestant foundation’s doctoral scholarship, open to international doctoral candidates admitted at a German university.

  • EUR 1,750 a month plus EUR 100 research allowance
  • Initially three years, extendable

Eligibility: Doctoral candidates admitted by a German university, usually Protestant church members, with German at B2/DSH; early-stage projects only.

How to apply: Deadlines are the first business day of December and of June.

title: Deutschlandstipendium at the Technical University of Munich (TUM)
description:
Germany’s national merit scholarship at TUM, open to admitted or enrolled international students.

  • EUR 300 a month

Eligibility: Admitted or enrolled TUM students of any nationality; you need German residence and a German bank account to accept.

How to apply: The 2027/28 application period runs in summer 2027. The Deutschlandstipendium pays EUR 300 a month (half federal, half private sponsors) for at least two semesters, regardless of income or nationality.

title: Deutschlandstipendium at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT)
description:
The national merit scholarship at KIT, open to students of all nationalities.

  • EUR 300 a month

Eligibility: Students of any nationality enrolled at KIT at the start of funding, with a German bank account.

How to apply: Apply online between 14 and 29 April 2027. The Deutschlandstipendium pays EUR 300 a month (half federal, half private sponsors) for at least two semesters, regardless of income or nationality.

title: Deutschlandstipendium at RWTH Aachen University
description:
The national merit scholarship at RWTH Aachen, Germany’s largest technical university.

  • EUR 300 a month

Eligibility: RWTH students of any nationality with strong results and engagement.

How to apply: The next application period is June 2027. The Deutschlandstipendium pays EUR 300 a month (half federal, half private sponsors) for at least two semesters, regardless of income or nationality.

title: RWTH Scholarship for Particularly Involved International Students (BEIS)
description:
A six-month stipend from RWTH’s International Office for international students who are especially engaged.

  • EUR 300 a month for about six months

Eligibility: Non-German students who earned their university entrance qualification outside Germany.

How to apply: The scholarship reopens for applications in 2027; the dates shown are an estimate.

title: TUM Scholarship for International Students
description:
One-off financial aid for international students at TUM.

  • EUR 500 to 1,500 per semester

Eligibility: International students enrolled at TUM.

How to apply: Check TUM’s scholarship pages for the next round.

title: Lithuanian State Scholarship for Full-Time Master’s Studies
description:
Lithuanian Government scholarships for foreigners from eligible countries to complete a full-time master’s in Lithuania.

  • EUR 560 a month

Eligibility: Citizens of listed countries (with quotas) not previously funded under this scheme; Lithuanian A1 required in year one; not combinable with other funding.

How to apply: The last call is closed; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: Latvian State Scholarships for Foreign Students
description:
Latvian Government scholarships for students from partner countries to study or research in Latvia; 104 awards from 22 nationalities in 2026/27.

  • Monthly state scholarship

Eligibility: Students and researchers from countries with bilateral agreements with Latvia.

How to apply: The next call is open from 1 February to 1 April 2027.

title: Estonian National Scholarship for International Degree Students
provider: Education and Youth Board of Estonia (Harno)
description:
Estonian national scholarships for master’s and PhD students from listed countries in all fields.

  • EUR 350 a month for master’s studies

Eligibility: Applicants from countries on Estonia’s official list.

How to apply: Conditions and the deadline are announced in August; the date shown is an estimate.

title: University of St. Gallen (HSG) Excellence Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships for international master’s students at HSG, including awards that cover tuition for the standard study period.

  • CHF 10,000 excellence scholarship
  • Tuition coverage for some foundation-funded awards (e.g. Starr International Foundation)
  • Need-based fee remission

Eligibility: International applicants to HSG master’s programmes.

How to apply: Check the HSG funding page for the application window.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Indonesia (AMINEF)
description:
AMINEF’s Fulbright Master’s Degree Scholarship funds one to two years of study at a US university in most fields.

  • Tuition
  • Monthly living stipend
  • Round-trip airfare
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a bachelor’s degree, GPA of at least 3.0 and an accepted English test score (clinical medicine excluded).

How to apply: Submit the online application by 15 February 2027.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Vietnam

The Fulbright Vietnamese Student Program fully funds master’s study in the United States.

  • Tuition
  • Monthly living stipend
  • Round-trip airfare
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Vietnamese citizens meeting the programme’s academic and English requirements.

Fulbright scholarships for Ugandans to pursue graduate study in the United States.

  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Ugandan citizens with the equivalent of a US bachelor’s degree, usually with about three years of work or teaching experience.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Tanzania

Fulbright scholarships for Tanzanian professionals to pursue graduate study in the United States.

Fulbright scholarships for Rwandans to pursue a master’s degree in the United States.

Fulbright scholarships for Zambian professionals to pursue graduate study in the United States.

  • Monthly living stipend

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Malawi

Fulbright scholarships for Malawians to pursue graduate study in the United States.

  • Monthly living stipend
  • Round-trip airfare

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program – Senegal

Fulbright scholarships for Senegalese graduates to earn a two-year master’s degree in the United States.

  • Monthly living stipend
  • Round-trip airfare
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Senegalese citizens living in Senegal with a master’s (or Master 1 + 2) who have not studied in the US for more than a semester.

  • Funding for PhD study at Cambridge (see the College for current value)

How to apply: Apply through the Cambridge graduate application; the funding deadline is usually in early January.

title: Obama Foundation Scholars Program at Columbia University
description:
A fully funded nine-month residency at Columbia for emerging leaders from around the world, with graduate courses and leadership training.

  • Fully funded residency at Columbia World Projects
  • Up to two graduate courses per semester
  • Leadership seminars and workshops

Eligibility: Global changemakers with a record of community impact (11 Scholars in the 2025-26 Columbia cohort).

How to apply: Check the Obama Foundation and Columbia pages for the next application window; the date shown is an estimate.

title: France Excellence Charpak Master’s Scholarship (India)
provider: Embassy of France in India / Campus France
description:
French Government scholarships for Indian students to study a master’s in France for one or two years.

  • EUR 860 monthly living allowance
  • Visa and Campus France fee exemptions
  • Social security

Eligibility: Indian students who have applied to a French institution for a full-time master’s (PhD and research stays excluded); no GPA cut-off; French is an asset but not required.

How to apply: Apply online on Campus France India; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: ENS de Lyon Ampère Scholarship of Excellence
description:
Excellence scholarships for international students on master’s programmes in sciences, arts, humanities and social sciences at ENS de Lyon.

  • EUR 1,000 a month for 12 months

Eligibility: Non-French citizens who started university outside France, applying for M1 (with 180 ECTS) or M2 (with 240 ECTS).

How to apply: The 2026-27 call ran 14 November 2025 to 23 January 2026; the next call is expected on similar dates.

title: KAAD Scholarship Programme for Postgraduate Study in Germany
description:
Scholarships from the German Catholic academic exchange service for graduates from Africa, Asia, the Middle East and Latin America to do a master’s or PhD in Germany.

  • Scholarship for postgraduate study in Germany
  • In-country master’s scholarships in Ghana, Kenya, Ethiopia, Zimbabwe, Jordan and Lebanon

Eligibility: Graduates with professional experience living in a developing country in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or Latin America, usually Catholic or Christian (others if proposed by Catholic partners).

How to apply: Apply through the KAAD partner committee in your country; deadlines vary.

title: ICTP Postgraduate Diploma Programme Scholarship
provider: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
description:
A one-year postgraduate diploma in Trieste in physics or mathematics preparing talented graduates from developing countries for a PhD; there are no course fees.

  • Scholarship and travel grant for students from developing countries
  • No course fees

Eligibility: Candidates under about 28 with a degree roughly equivalent to an MSc in physics or mathematics, from UN, UNESCO or IAEA member states.

How to apply: The last deadline was 28 February; the 2027 call is still to be announced, so the date is an estimate.

title: Weizmann Institute Feinberg Graduate School MSc Fellowship
description:
Every full-time MSc student at the Weizmann Institute receives a fellowship; teaching is in English.

  • NIS 7,000 a month for 24 months
  • Incentive top-up for students with external fellowships

Eligibility: Students admitted on academic excellence to Feinberg MSc programmes in physics, chemistry, life sciences, mathematics, computer science or science teaching.

How to apply: Apply online to the Feinberg Graduate School; the deadline shown is an estimate.

title: Weizmann Institute Feinberg Graduate School PhD Fellowship
description:
Full fellowships for PhD students at one of the world’s leading research institutes, in Rehovot.

  • NIS 9,000 a month for 4.5 years
  • Incentive top-up for external fellowship winners
  • Travel allowance

Eligibility: Students with an MSc (usually required) admitted to a Feinberg PhD programme; contact a potential supervisor first.

How to apply: Contact a supervisor, then apply online; admission runs year-round, so the date shown is an estimate.

title: EMBL International PhD Programme
description:
Fully funded life-science PhD positions at EMBL’s six sites in Germany, France, Italy, the UK and Spain, with no application fee.

  • 48-month contract
  • First-year stipend of roughly EUR 3,000-4,100 a month by site
  • Health care and pension benefits

Eligibility: Applicants of any nationality holding (or about to hold) a degree that qualifies them for a PhD, by October of the start year.

How to apply: The Winter round closed on 12 October 2026; the Summer 2027 round opens at the end of January, so the deadline shown is an estimate.

title: SISSA PhD Fellowships
provider: SISSA – International School for Advanced Studies
description:
Every admitted PhD student at SISSA in Trieste receives a fellowship, in physics, mathematics and neuroscience; no age or nationality limits.

  • EUR 1,120 net per month
  • Top-up for students with other scholarships

Eligibility: Candidates with a master’s-level degree (or due by 31 October); non-EU candidates should use the preselection track based on academic qualifications.

How to apply: Calls run from February to August; non-EU preselection results come by the end of May. The date shown is an estimate.

title: Gran Sasso Science Institute PhD Scholarships
description:
Four-year funded PhDs at GSSI in L’Aquila in astroparticle physics, mathematics, computer science and regional science, taught in English.

  • EUR 16,243 gross a year
  • 50% extra for approved research periods abroad
  • Accommodation in the first year (or a cash equivalent)

Eligibility: Holders of a master’s-level degree (or a foreign degree of at least four years) assessed by the selection committee; about half of students are international.

How to apply: The last winter round closed on 13 January 2026 with a second round to 15 May; the 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: Liverpool Attainment Scholarship for India
description:
A tuition discount for Indian nationals joining a taught master’s at the University of Liverpool.

  • £2,000 tuition discount

Eligibility: Indian nationals paying international fees who meet the deposit deadlines; not for previous Liverpool students or fully sponsored students.

How to apply: Check the scholarship page for 2027/28 terms and deposit deadlines.

title: University of Liverpool International Postgraduate Taught Scholarship
description:
An automatic tuition reduction for high-achieving international students on a one-year taught master’s at Liverpool.

  • £2,500 off first-year tuition

Eligibility: New overseas-fee master’s students with a UK first-class degree or equivalent.

How to apply: Awarded automatically when you meet the criteria; confirm current terms with the university.

title: Newcastle University Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship (Undergraduate)
description:
£7,000 a year off tuition for the whole course for international undergraduates from listed countries starting at Newcastle in September 2027.

  • £7,000 tuition credit per academic year

Eligibility: Applicants domiciled in listed countries (including India, Malaysia, Hong Kong, the USA and EU states) with an offer for an eligible city-centre course, assessed as international.

How to apply: Apply via UCAS by 13 January 2027; offer holders by 31 March must make Newcastle Firm or Insurance choice by 3 May 2027. No separate form.

title: University of Reading Master’s Excellence Scholarship
description:
Tuition reductions of £4,000-£10,000 for international master’s students at Reading in 2027/28, based on academic record.

  • £4,000 to £10,000 off tuition

Eligibility: International fee-paying students starting a taught master’s in 2027/28.

How to apply: Considered automatically; no separate deadline.

title: University of Reading Global Sustainability Leaders Scholarship
description:
Living-cost support for international undergraduates with a commitment to sustainability at Reading.

  • £6,000 a year for up to four years towards living costs

Eligibility: International undergraduate applicants for 2027 entry.

How to apply: The 2027 deadline is not yet confirmed; the date shown is an estimate.

title: University of Reading International PhD Studentships
description:
Funded PhD studentships for international doctoral researchers starting at Reading in October 2027.

  • International-rate tuition fees
  • Stipend for Reading-based study
  • £1,000 a year training allowance

Eligibility: International applicants to a Reading PhD.

How to apply: The deadline is 15 January 2027.

title: Loughborough University International Excellence Scholarship
description:
An automatic award of up to £3,000 a year for international undergraduates starting at Loughborough in September 2027.

  • Up to £3,000 for every year of study (excluding placement or study-abroad years)

Eligibility: International undergraduate applicants for September 2027 entry.

How to apply: No separate application; you are considered from your UCAS application.

title: Loughborough University Undergraduate Future Leaders Scholarship
description:
A £10,000 first-year tuition discount for international undergraduates at Loughborough.

  • £10,000 off first-year tuition

Eligibility: Self-funded international undergraduates for 2027 entry.

How to apply: Check the page for how to be considered.

title: King’s Business School Postgraduate Scholarships
description:
Awards of up to £10,000 or 50% of fees for MSc students at King’s Business School, with a Global scholarship that welcomes students from the Global South.

  • Up to £10,000 or 50% of tuition fees

Eligibility: Offer holders who have firmly accepted a King’s Business School MSc place.

How to apply: Considered automatically by the Scholarship Committee (meets in April and July); the 2026 cut-off was 31 March, so the 2027 date is an estimate.

title: CMA CGM Excellence Fund for Education at King’s College London
description:
A full scholarship for overseas-fee master’s students at King’s College London, funded by the CMA CGM Group.

  • Full tuition waiver
  • £22,161 stipend

Eligibility: Master’s offer holders with overseas fee status.

How to apply: The 2026-27 deadline was 28 April 2026; the 2027 date is an estimate.

title: University of Dundee Global Excellence Scholarship (Postgraduate)
description:
A tuition discount for international students with a first-class degree starting a taught master’s at Dundee in September 2027 or January 2028.

  • £3,000 tuition fee discount

Eligibility: International fee-paying students with a UK first-class degree or equivalent and an offer for a full-time on-campus master’s costing at least £19,900.

How to apply: The September 2027 intake closes on 14 October 2027.

title: University of Stirling Vice-Chancellor’s Postgraduate International Scholarship
description:
A £7,000 tuition waiver for international master’s students at the University of Stirling.

  • £7,000 tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: International students starting a taught master’s at Stirling.

How to apply: Check the scholarship page for September 2027 terms; the date shown is an estimate.

title: Williams College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Williams meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students, with aid guaranteed for four years; about 70% of international students get aid.

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need (average award above USD 90,000 a year)
  • Free textbooks and supplies
  • One round-trip flight home each year

Eligibility: International applicants who answer “Yes” to the financial aid question on the application (admission is need-aware).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Vassar College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Vassar meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international first-years who apply for aid at admission (35-45 funded each year).

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need

Eligibility: International first-year applicants (need-aware); international transfers are not eligible.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Middlebury College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Middlebury’s aid offers cover 100% of demonstrated need for all four years, with small loans of USD 1,000-3,500 a year.

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need for four years
  • Small loan component

Eligibility: International applicants; financial need may be considered in admission.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Grinnell College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Grinnell meets 100% of each student’s demonstrated need with grants, scholarships and campus jobs, including for international students.

  • Grants and scholarships meeting 100% of demonstrated need
  • Campus employment

Eligibility: International applicants who submit the CSS Profile (or Grinnell’s ISAFA) with their application.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Macalester College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Macalester meets the full demonstrated need of every student it admits, with four-year packages for international students.

  • Grants
  • Small Macalester International Student Loan
  • Campus employment

Eligibility: International first-year applicants; those with the highest need face the most competition.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Smith College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Need-based aid for international students at Smith, plus free tuition from fall 2026 for families earning up to USD 150,000 under the Next 150 Pledge.

  • Need-based aid
  • Free tuition for eligible families (Next 150 Pledge)
  • Health grant for aided international students

Eligibility: Non-US citizens who apply for aid before admission (otherwise never eligible).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Bryn Mawr College Financial Aid for International Students

Need-based aid for international students at Bryn Mawr, assured for four years and renewed automatically.

Eligibility: Non-US citizens and permanent residents who apply for aid as first-year applicants.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: University of Chicago Financial Aid for International Students
description:
UChicago covers 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students with loan-free aid packages.

  • Loan-free aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need

Eligibility: International first-year applicants who apply for aid during admission; transfers are not eligible.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Northwestern University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need for all four years for admitted first-years, including a small group of international students each year.

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need for four years

Eligibility: International first-year applicants (admission is need-aware).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Vanderbilt University Scholarships for International Students

Need-based and merit scholarships for a limited number of international first-years; 89 students from 54 countries were offered aid for fall 2026.

  • Merit scholarships

Eligibility: International first-year applicants who file the CSS Profile or ISFAA.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Rice University Financial Aid for International Students

International students who receive need-based aid at Rice have 100% of demonstrated need met with grants.

Eligibility: International applicants using the CSS Profile (admission is need-aware; not eligible for the Rice Investment).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Johns Hopkins University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Johns Hopkins meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted students, including international students.

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need

Eligibility: International applicants who request aid on the admission application and submit the CSS Profile (need-aware; transfers not eligible).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Tufts University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Tufts meets 100% of the demonstrated need of every admitted student regardless of citizenship, and waives application fees for international aid applicants.

  • Aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need
  • Application fee and CSS Profile fee waivers

Eligibility: International applicants who flag their need for aid when they apply (Tufts offers no merit scholarships).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Emory University Need-Based Aid for International Students
description:
Need-based financial aid awards for a select group of international applicants to Emory each year.

  • Need-based financial aid

Eligibility: International Regular Decision applicants who answer yes to the aid question and file the CSS Profile by 5 February 2027.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: University of Notre Dame Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Notre Dame reviews international undergraduates need-blind and meets full demonstrated need for all undergraduates regardless of citizenship.

  • Aid meeting full demonstrated need
  • Need-blind admission for international applicants

Eligibility: International first-year applicants who submit the CSS Profile.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Caltech Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Need-based institutional aid for international students applying as first-years to Caltech.

  • Need-based institutional aid

Eligibility: International students applying as incoming first-years (not transfers or 3/2).

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Haverford College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Haverford meets the full demonstrated need of all admitted students, including a limited number of international students each year.

  • Aid meeting full demonstrated need (international travel not included)

Eligibility: International first-year applicants (Early Decision I or II, or Regular Decision); not available to transfers or to students who did not get aid in year one.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

Mount Holyoke meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students, including international students; 45% of incoming international students get aid or merit awards.

  • Merit scholarships (average about USD 17,500)
  • Loans and campus jobs

Eligibility: International applicants who indicate on the application that they will apply for need-based aid and submit the CSS Profile.
